cases.expected_behavior: Empty ledger stays None. A lost request is incomplete. token_count_source=missing cannot invent tok/s.
fail / timeout / cancel / incomplete stay in the error numerator and measured denominator. Incomplete is never success.
Zero-token, single-token, and missing provenance rows keep TPOT N/A — never 0.
Search-phase +50% is search_winner only. Not confirmed_improvement. Not is_confirmed_promotable. Reflect remasures.
Disagreeing confirmation pairs stay too_noisy. Reflect remasures under the cap. Not promotable.
Confirmation no_diff → ⑥ stop_reason=no_reliable_improvement. Not a promote.
Propose tool error emits Tune propose_tool_error. No budget. No forged summary. Stale latest ignored. No promote.
BenchmarkError without exc.result forges no row/metrics. Budget −1 once. No promote.
Persisted failed contract row is kept. is_promotable false. current_attempt_latest is that row.
Mid-slot fail records completed run_id. No ⑤ decision. Remasure under cap. best_summary identity unchanged.
tool_exception on this attempt. Reflect does not treat prior success as current. Bind cleared.
Tool is not called at interrupt. One benchmark on resume. No confirmed promote.
Search persist is reused. Confirm slots reuse _rN_ ids. Campaign budget −1 once.
Second resume matches budget / tried ids / run_ids. No duplicate attempt.
Uninterrupted vs interrupted+resumed match the full comparable end-state.
Startup-ok + ack_lost + lookup miss persists Week-1 insufficient_evidence. code=ack_lost. No promote. Resume does not re-bench.
Ack-lost + save fail: result_persisted=false, validity_status=insufficient_evidence, no forged row, no promote.
Executor and Reflect steps carry retry_count, budget_consumed, next_action, stop_reason. Planner must not.
A failed unrun row is stored. get_promotable_result is None. promotable_only excludes it.
High RPS without critical evidence stays insufficient_evidence. ① is_promotable false. Not best.
Mismatched actual vs requested derives invalid. Remembered, never promotable.
CLI-only actual (missing non-CLI knobs) is insufficient_evidence. ① stays closed.
successful_requests=0 derives failed. Remembered, not promotable.
Legacy / incomplete rows default to insufficient_evidence with a stable legacy run_id. Reload does not promote.
Retrying the same failed config upserts one remembered failed row. Still not promotable.
OOM-at-start failed row is remembered. A Week-1-valid neighbor can be promotable; the OOM row cannot.
Mixed failed / unevidenced / invalid / valid rows: promotable_only returns only the Week-1-valid row.
